results: Proposition 12.4.3 now proves equality of ordinary envelopes for every smooth obstacle throughout a relative envelope class, for any smooth real background admitting the potentials. Proposition 15.6.6 identifies the ideal envelope below an obstacle with the ordinary envelope of the zero-obstacle ideal representative. Under bounded mass and positive lower ideal volume, Proposition 29.8.1 makes zero-obstacle envelope equality equivalent to relative-envelope membership and equality at every smooth obstacle. The zero-lower-volume and general no-BMP implications in higher dimension remain unresolved.
review_scope: The complete all-obstacle input and the changed definition, two strengthened propositions with their proofs, and bounded Chapter 15, Introduction and Chapter 32 interfaces receive two mathematical/editorial reads; the second follows the first build and visual inspection. Exact relative-envelope, ideal-projection and full-mass dependencies are checked at their recorded scope. This is a bounded seven-input revision, not a new full-chapter or whole-book proof audit.
next_unit: Investigate the zero-lower-volume obstacle-projection problem in closed higher-dimensional backgrounds, using analytic residual classes and product or fibration reductions. Establish a valid criterion or counterexample without assuming that ordinary projection commutes with obstacle changes; retain the general no-BMP question separately.
